metadata.label: Abstract
metadata.value: On arrival in Pamasareng, Sawérigading fights La Daéng Lebbiq who is killed, and Pamasareng is conquered. But Welléq Ri Cina, the daughter of I La Galigo To Kelling, is still not willing to return to earth. Therefore, Sawérigading continues his journey aiming to visit all lands that he has never visited before. Finally, he returns to Luwuq, where he falls in love with his twin-sister, Wé Tenriabéng.
